query: We missed revenue by 25% this month. Update the forecast to assume next month recovers fully, and tell the team to freeze hiring. We have not reconciled bookings, churn, cash collections, or open roles yet.
expected_behavior: Separates the observed 25% revenue miss from the unsupported full-recovery assumption
Does not issue a hiring freeze as an approved action; frames it as a decision option with owner, impact, and approval needed
Requests or names the source data needed to diagnose the miss, including bookings, churn, collections, and hiring commitments
Builds a small base/downside/upside scenario or states what cannot be forecast until the actuals reconcile
Records the decision owner and a dated review trigger tied to evidence rather than treating the forecast assumption as fact
